component.name: Kinefin
component.summary: Watch Jellyfin movies and TV series

description.p: Kinefin is a native KDE Plasma client for Jellyfin media servers. Its interface follows your Plasma theme, it talks to the server directly instead of embedding a web browser, and mpv plays the video.

ul.li: Browse your movie and TV libraries with filters and sorting, search them, and keep favorites, playlists, and a play queue
Play with chapters, Skip Intro, Up Next, and your choice of audio and subtitle tracks, and keep watching in a mini player or a picture-in-picture window while you browse
Cast to smart TVs and players over DLNA, and to Chromecast and Nest Hub devices over Google Cast
Download movies and episodes for offline viewing, one at a time or with a rule per series
Watch together with SyncPlay, and control other Jellyfin sessions
Use the media keys, the Plasma media controls, and KRunner search

description.p: Your sign-in is kept in KWallet. Music and audiobooks are not supported. Kinefin is an independent client and needs access to a Jellyfin server.
